summary: Full regression across day-01 through day-04 plus the product smoke check on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844). Add, trim, empty input, long titles, bulk add, toggle, delete, keyboard-only, reload, and fast clicks all behaved as specified with no console errors. No bugs found; known-bugs list was empty.
